name: Pump
tip: Tempo locked volume pump, like sidechain from a kick. Needs no kick.

name: Trance Gate
tip: Step gate for rhythmic chopping. Draw the 16 steps on the page.

name: Transient
tip: Shape the punch and the tail of a sound separately.

ps.tip: Positive adds punch at the start of notes, negative softens it.
Positive makes the tail longer and fuller, negative makes it tighter.

name: Distortion
tip: Ten distortion curves, oversampled so it stays smooth. Tone smooths the top.

ps.tip: Shape of the distortion curve.
How hard the signal is pushed into the curve.
Shifts the curve for even harmonics and a rounder, buzzier edge.

name: Fat Drive
tip: Saturator that thickens: eight flavours plus a low band boost for weight. Warm to nasty.

ps.tip: Character of the saturation.
Amount of saturation.

name: Crusher
tip: Bit depth and sample rate reducer for digital grit. From lo-fi to harsh.

ps.tip: Bit depth. Lower is rougher.
Keeps every Nth sample. Higher is more aliasing and grit.
Randomises the sample timing for a noisy, broken sound.

name: Wavefolder
tip: Folds the wave back on itself: metallic, rich harmonics that move as the level changes.

ps.tip: How far the wave is pushed into the fold.
Number of folds in a row. More is busier.

name: Freq Shifter
tip: Moves every frequency up or down by a fixed amount in Hz. Metallic, inharmonic and weird.

ps.tip: Positive shifts up, negative shifts down. Small values give a slow phasing swirl.
Feeds the output back in for rising or falling spirals.
Shifts left and right in opposite directions for width.

name: Ring Mod
tip: Multiplies the sound with an oscillator for bell-like and robot tones.

Shape of the modulator.

name: Vowel
tip: Talking filter. Morphs through A, E, I, O, U.

ps.tip: 0 is A, 1 is E, 2 is I, 3 is O, 4 is U. Sweep it for talking.
Moves all formants up or down by up to an octave. Child to giant.

Saturation before the formants for a growling voice.

name: Reverb
tip: Ten reverb characters on one dense engine: room, plate, hall, cathedral, chamber, spring, shimmer, gated, bloom and ambient.

ps.tip: Room is small and lively. Plate is bright and dense. Hall and Cathedral are big. Chamber is in between. Spring drips. Shimmer adds an octave up. Gated cuts the tail. Bloom swells in. Ambient is a huge soft wash.

ps.tip: What gets shaped. Saw, Pulse and Chord follow the notes you play. Noise whispers. Self reshapes the track with its own tone (use Formant shift). Track 1 to 4 use the sound of another track of this synth.
Number of bands. Few is rough and robotic, many is clearer.

name: Autotune
tip: Pulls what you play onto a key and scale. It knows the notes from the synth itself, so there is no detection and no delay. With glide or pitch bend it gives the stepped, hard-tuned sound. Best on single lines.

ps.tip: Root note of the scale.
Notes that are allowed. Notes outside the scale are moved to the nearest one. Chromatic only steps glides and bends.
0 jumps to the note at once: the robotic, stepped sound. Slower is more natural.
How far the pitch is pulled to the scale.
Extra shift after tuning, for a harmony voice. Use Mix to blend it with the original.
Fine tune in cents.
Grain size of the pitch shifter. Short is tight, long is smoother.
Dry/wet balance of this effect. 100% is fully processed.

Asymmetric soft clip with even harmonics: warm and thick, not buzzy.

Delays the right side by a few milliseconds for width. Check it in mono.
